versions.title: Special Edition, the last build before the Anniversary update (2021)
versions.source: Depot manifests from a community Steam downgrade shell script's per-game block for Skyrim Special Edition, contributed 2026-11-06. The three content depots are the ones Steam installs for the base game; Skyrim SE has no separate DLC depots, so this is the whole install. NOT yet verified against a download — confirm SkyrimSE.exe reports 1.5.97.0 after switching and move this note.

versions.title: Anniversary Edition, the build most SKSE64 setups are written for

versions.title: The last 1.6.x build, the one SKSE64 2.2.x supports, before Steam's 1.7.x
versions.source: Depot manifests from a community Steam downgrade shell script's per-game block for Skyrim Special Edition, contributed 2026-11-06. This is the same target Utils/modding_tools/skyrim_runtime.py patches to from 1.7.104, so a switch here and an SRS runtime swap should land on the same build. NOT yet verified against a download — confirm SkyrimSE.exe reports 1.6.1170.0 after switching and move this note.

versions.title: Anniversary Edition, Steam's current build (build 24914197), the one SKSE64 2.3.1 supports
versions.source: Depot manifests read from the appmanifest of a real Steam install of build 24914197 on the public branch, 2026-11-21. Checked against that install: SkyrimSE.exe reports 1.7.104.0 and its size (37,910,440 bytes) is depot 489833's size in the appmanifest. NOT yet verified by downloading these manifests through Steam.
